decisions.reason: Because the firm has already invested in this product and it builds on established capabilities, management will likely view early results as temporary and persist rather than drop it.
Although distant from the established offer, the launch of a multi-model product line signals substantial public commitment and sunk resources, making the firm reluctant to abandon it quickly.
As a multi-model product line that builds on the firm's established offer, it has high sunk investment and centrality, so management will likely justify and continue the commitment.
Even as a single-model extension, it builds on established expertise and has been publicly announced, leading management to persist and attribute any disappointments to temporary causes.
Similar to the other ground sleeves, this product benefits from sunk costs and public commitment, and the firm is unlikely to drop it within the coming year.
